chapter.verse: Amaute in kei tungah, “ Topa ’ innah pai ni,” hong cih uh ciangin ka kipak hi.
Jerusalem aw, na kulh kongpi sungah kote hong tungin ka ding khin ta uh hi.

Jerusalem khuapi pen, Israelte tungah thu a kipiaksa bangin Topa ’ tungah lungdamna a ko dingin Topa ’ minamte, minamte a hong paitohna, khuapi lian tawh kibang-a a kibawl, kip tak-a a kilam bikbek ahi hi.
David innkuante’ kumpi tokhom ahi, thukhen nading kumpi tokhom tua lai-ah kikoih hi.
Jerusalem khuapi’ nopsak nading thu ngen un la, “Nang hong itte a dau uh pai ta hen!
Na kulhte sungah lungnopna om hen la, na galvilna tausangte’ huam sungah lungmuan’na om ta hen” ci un.
Sanggamte leh kikholhpihte ka khualna-in, “Nang sungah nopna om ta hen!” ka ci ding hi.
Topa i Pasian’ inn ka khualna-in nangma nopsakna ka zong ding hi.
